title: Crazy Damage
description: Advanced PvP enhancement plugin with damage multipliers, totem limiter, and anti-farming protection for balanced competitive gameplay.
body:
# ⚡ CrazyDamage - Revolutionary PvP Enhancement

Transform your Minecraft PvP experience with powerful Havoc items, intelligent totem management, and sophisticated anti-abuse systems!

## 🎮 Key Features

### ⚔️ **Havoc Damage System**
- **Exponential Damage Multiplier**: Stack damage buffs up to 32x (2^5)!
- **Timed Buffs**: Configurable duration (default: 60 seconds)
- **Action Bar Countdown**: Real-time timer display
- **Kill Rewards**: Earn Havoc items by defeating opponents

### 🛡️ **Intelligent Totem Limiter**
- **Per-Life Limits**: Configure max totem uses before respawn
- **Automatic Reset**: Counters reset after death
- **Customizable Messages**: Full control over player notifications
- **Easy Toggle**: Enable/disable via commands or config

### 🚫 **Anti-Farming Protection**
- **Kill Cooldowns**: Prevent repeated farming of same players
- **Configurable Duration**: Default 5-hour cooldown between same kills
- **Smart Tracking**: Each player-victim pair tracked independently
- **Bypass Permission**: Give trusted players exemption

### 🎯 **Command System**
- **/crazy give <player> <amount> - Give Havoc items**
- **/crazy reload - Reload configuration**
- **/crazy info - Show plugin statistics**
- **/crazy totem - Manage totem limiter**
- **/crazy cooldown - Check/manage anti-farming**
- **/crazy reset <player> - Reset player stats**
